issue: JSON numeric output does not preserve binary64 negative zero when serialized as -0 and parsed as an integer.
impact: No driver, runtime implementation, comparator, or freeze change required.
resolution: The production comparison harness already decodes JSON integer-form token -0 as binary64 -0.0 using parse_int. The standalone diagnostic used default json.loads; it did not expose a comparator or C++ arithmetic defect.
